title: Swarm definition (MAT-45)
description: Schema for defining parallel dispatch to multiple candidates with consensus strategies.

name.description: Unique swarm identifier (lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens)

description.description: Human-readable description of the swarm's purpose

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode: parallel_model (multiple CLI adapters) or variant (multiple agent variants)

candidates.description: For parallel_model: CLI adapter identifiers (claude, codex, gemini) registered in MAT-16. For variant: agent names from the agents/ directory.

consensus_strategy.description: Strategy for combining candidate responses. Valid values depend on dispatch_mode.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump when swarm definition shape changes.

consensus_strategy_notes.description: Notes on consensus strategies: return-all for parallel_model returns all candidate outputs without picking a winner, intended for use cases where an external step (e.g. an orchestrator or synthesis skill) will process all outputs.
